correctness.rationale: The 20-vertex cubic graph is explicitly reconstructed by two algorithms. A degree argument excludes sets of size at most 6, and exhaustive 20-choose-7 and 20-choose-8 checks certify minimum 8 and exactly 190 optima. Every ordered one-vertex replacement is checked for membership in the full set, then component and eccentricity computations exhaust all 190 states. Independent generalized-Petersen bitset reconstruction reproduces 360 exchanges, 150+40 components, and radius/diameter 10 in the core. All 20-choose-12 possible complementary subsets are scanned for induced cycles, proving the exact set equivalence. Explicit 120-automorphism enumeration certifies the five orbit sizes. Scripts and assertions are included; no sampling-to-infinity inference.

originality.rationale: Cao, Lin and Shi (2009) determine the numerical minimum for GP(n,2), including eight for GP(10,2), but do not classify one-vertex exchange connectivity. Alikhani et al. (2017) define a different add/delete reconfiguration graph over cardinalities up to a bound; their broad properties do not entail this exact fixed-cardinality exchange graph. Direct targeted searches and mathematical-record comparisons found no published claim of a 150-vertex connected component, forty isolated minimum total dominating sets characterized by complementary induced twelve-cycles, or uniform core eccentricity ten. This is best-knowledge priority only, not global uniqueness.
residual_risks: An unindexed dodecahedral configuration or induced-cycle catalogue might encode the same exchange invariants indirectly.

value.rationale: The regular dodecahedron is a canonical and highly symmetric cubic graph with natural minimum total-dominating sensor configurations. Whether the minimum-cost configurations remain reachable by one-for-one relocation is a motivated structural invariant, not inferable from the known size-8 optimum. The result finds forty genuinely frozen configurations and a connected 150-configuration core of uniform eccentricity ten, explains all frozen states as complements of induced twelve-cycles, and completely classifies automorphism orbit types. The characterization is a meaningful finite structural boundary for optimal reconfiguration rather than an arbitrary slice or small numerical improvement.
